name: Default
shortDescription: Backup client with a web UI that stores encrypted, incremental, compressed backups on S3, B2, WebDAV, SFTP and other cloud or remote storage.

alerts.message: Sign in with the generated DUPLICATI__WEBSERVICE_PASSWORD value. It is re-applied on every restart, so change the password in the environment, not in the UI. Keep SETTINGS_ENCRYPTION_KEY: without it the stored settings and credentials cannot be decrypted.
